TemplateStylesExtenderCustomPropertiesDe.description: Allow CSS custom properties (--*) to be declared.

TemplateStylesExtenderExtendCustomProper.description: Allow var() in properties whose own grammar has no slot for it, such as width, transform, and the colour a relative colour starts from. Turning this off does not remove var() from the places css-sanitizer accepts it on its own, such as a whole colour or a colour channel.

TemplateStylesExtenderEnableUnscopingSup.description: Allow a templatestyles tag to scope its CSS to a class of its own, set with a wrapclass attribute, instead of .mw-parser-output. Takes effect only for a page whose last editor holds the right named by $wgTemplateStylesExtenderUnscopingPermission. Each such tag costs a lookup of that user.

TemplateStylesExtenderRequireFontFamilyP.description: Require @font-face family names to start with 'TemplateStyles', as TemplateStyles itself does. Off by default. @font-face is not scoped to .mw-parser-output, so a family declared on a TemplateStyles page applies to the whole rendered page, including skin chrome. Changing this does not invalidate already-rendered pages, which keep their previous CSS until purged.

TemplateStylesExtenderUnscopingPermissio.description: The right a user must hold to unscope CSS with a wrapclass attribute. Defaults to 'editinterface'.

TemplateStylesExtenderAllowExternalResou.description: Allow url(), image-set() and the other external-resource functions inside custom property (--*) values. Off by default: a custom property is substituted into the fetching property at render time (e.g. mask-image: var(--x)), so its URL cannot be checked against $wgTemplateStylesAllowedUrls. Enable this only on a wiki whose enforced Content-Security-Policy restricts such fetches to trusted hosts, because with it on that CSP is the only guard. A URL written directly in a typed property stays allowlist-checked either way.
